proposals.why: Insufficient as the 5-year architecture: weak seams for Inbox/Health/AI Phase-2, high risk of Actions/API sprawl continuing, under-invests in maintainability relative to Product Definition growth.
Best balance of maintainability, DX, business fit, cost, and migration complexity while enabling future growth without premature microservices.
modifications: MVP ships as a single Next.js deployable (A-style runtime) while enforcing B seams: bounded-context packages, application services, shared Zod contracts.
Async workers are optional until Health/insights/notification load requires them; spike allowed, not mandatory for MVP cut.
Typed API facade (/api/v1 or oRPC) is mandatory for new read models and any cross-client contracts; existing Server Actions may strangler-migrate, not big-bang delete.
Candidate C service split is explicitly NOT authorized now; only allowed later via a new Architecture Decision Board if metrics/org demand.

proposals.why: Over-engineered for current household scale and team shape; high migration/ops cost; distributed Month Ritual risk. May be revisited only after B seams exist and load/org justify split.

technology_stack.backend: Next.js server (Server Actions + Route Handlers) with application-service layer per bounded context
technology_stack.orm_data_access: Supabase client + SQL; Drizzle optional for typed server repositories (not mandatory rewrite)
technology_stack.authentication: Supabase Auth SSR with proxy.ts session refresh
technology_stack.authorization: Supabase RLS (is_household_member) + app-layer admin gates per Product Permission Matrix
technology_stack.api_style: Zod-validated application commands/queries; HTTP JSON facade under /api/v1 (or oRPC equivalent) for read models and externalizable contracts; Server Actions allowed as UI adapters calling the same services
technology_stack.folder_structure: Monorepo single app + packages/modules sliced by bounded context: tenancy, ledger, plan, inbox, health; app routes grouped by product IA (home, money, plan, inbox, together)
technology_stack.state_management: RSC as server truth; TanStack Query for client server-state; Zustand only for ephemeral UI state
technology_stack.caching: HTTP/CDN caching for public assets; TanStack Query cache for client; server-side request memoization; no offline write cache; Future offline-read is out of scope for this decision
technology_stack.infrastructure: Managed Supabase + Vercel (or equivalent Node host for Next); managed worker platform when workers enabled (e.g. Inngest/Trigger.dev/Edge Functions)
technology_stack.deployment: Git-based preview + production deploys for web; Supabase migrations via controlled pipeline
technology_stack.testing: Unit (Vitest) for domain/services; contract tests for API/facade; Playwright e2e for Home/Money/Plan/Inbox/Ritual critical paths
technology_stack.monitoring: Error tracking (Sentry or equivalent) + OpenTelemetry traces/metrics when workers/API facade land
technology_stack.logging: Structured JSON logs with request_id + household_id; PII redaction required
technology_stack.package_manager: npm as the single standard (lockfile source of truth); discontinue dual bun/npm ambiguity for CI
technology_stack.monorepo_strategy: Single repository; app at root (or apps/web later if needed); domain code in packages/* or modules/*; ai-os remains control-plane colocated but not product runtime

principles: Product Definition v2 is SoT; architecture serves Home/Money/Plan/Inbox/Together and BR-01 real≠virtual.
Bounded contexts: Tenancy, Real Ledger, Intention Plan/Inbox, Insight/Health — enforced as module seams.
One domain path for mutations: UI adapters (Actions) and HTTP facade call the same application services.
Online-first money mutations; offline writes forbidden (BR-15).
Strangler over big-bang; expand/contract data changes.
Security: RLS tenancy non-negotiable; admin elevation remains app-layer.
Observability is part of the architecture, not an afterthought.
No microservices until a future Architecture Decision Board authorizes C-style split.
